record_scope: HISTORICAL_PHASE3_DESIGN; embedded source retired from active tree in Phase 4

entries.decision: No equivalent Core CloudOps resource/receipt schema. Preserve strict fields, UTC, UUIDv7, canonical hashes and state validators.
Domain reads only. Core ExecutionEngine generic shell/browser tools are not equivalent exact-target CloudOps readers.
Preserve inert proposal, canonical parameters, evidence fingerprint, TTL and exact hash/version binding.
Core admission and AgentRuntime.safeguards.kill_switch outside domain policy. Never replace PLAN_AND_CONFIRM with generic tool confirmation.
Core commands.local_commands and webapp._handle_nonzero supply trusted operator admission; nonce/expiry/exact domain decision remain. No second auth server or credential.
Core tools.executor.ExecutionEngine._request_approval is unbound ENTER confirmation, not a substitute for durable domain authorization.
Retain compare-and-set ownership and atomic mutation+receipt, no duplicate execution. No generic equivalent in Core.
Use Core runtime_state_dir child native-v1 and service lease. Domain checkpoint store is not a global provenance system. Existing CPLTraceStore handles CPL states only.
Separate persisted read-back after execution, linked receipt; no success solely from proposal/model response.
Keep sanitized typed projections, replace runtime/framework labels with truthful Core native labels.
Explicit deterministic synthetic inventory, no AWS credential discovery and no external transport.
Explicit unavailable boundary in phase 3; no native live backend certification or mutation. Historical AWS implementation remains reference-only, never auto-loaded.

No Strands agent/factory/global manager. Portable domain advisor emits untrusted candidate JSON; any future real model must use existing runtime.providers.manager.ProviderManager exact calls after separate approval.
Use existing WebRuntimeService/make_server and _handle_nonzero: loopback Host, Origin, session token, explicit intent. Do not port LocalApiApplication.
No duplicate UI/session/cookie application. Preserve Core UI, no hackathon UI transplant.
Core /nonzero and typed service; baseline scripts run only as reference gates outside runtime.
Explicit typed portable default, disabled/malformed/aws unavailable states. Ignore ambient AWS/Bedrock selectors. No baseline environment parser.
One aioa-sparkhat wheel, optional nonzero extra only domain validation/UUID dependencies. No second project, Strands SDK, baseline data or runtime pip/Git.
Frozen 1447-test oracle plus native parity and clean installed-wheel tests. Do not edit oracle tests to make native tests pass.
Use actual AppendOnlyProvenanceStore.append_event and verify_provenance_chain. Domain AuditEvent records checkpoint facts, not a competing global chain. Hashes prove linkage/integrity, never truth.
Preserved only under unchanged baseline for reference and licensing; no deployment, workflow, second package or Git operations.

entries.native: models/contracts.py and state snapshot only where schema validators require them
entries.decision: Preserve dependent typed compatibility fields; do not register old autonomous executors or launchers. Live CloudWatch/Dynamo parity deferred.
